scenes.voice: Your database leaks. Are the passwords safe?
Never store plain text. Fast hashes like SHA-256 are cheap for attackers to guess.

lines.t: fast hashes are cheap to guess

scenes.voice: Use a slow, salted hash built for passwords, like bcrypt or argon2.
A unique salt per password stops reused lookup tables. The library adds it for you.
Which one do you use, bcrypt or argon2? Tell me in the comments.
Save this for the next time you store a password.
